answer: Because of that, anyone who spins up 45 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 22 times the capital for one share. Each collapsed cluster gets one haven weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The ledge report publishes the merge explicitly at each basalt. A farm of 4018 identities would post 2269 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
